description:
The newest member of our award-winning eMTB range, the Vitus E-Mythique LT is a riot on the descent and a magic carpet on the climb.

Powered by our own custom tuned Bafang M510 motor system developed in partnership with Bafang, it blends the ethos of our award-winning Mythique trail bike with the downhill performance of the E-Sommet . The result is an eMTB that inspires confidence in big terrain, both up and down the mountain.

Packing 170mm of travel in the front and 160mm in the rear, it’s a long travel variation of the Mythique that incorporates learnings from our current E-Sommet range into an eMTB that is ready to ride anything. Whether it’s a steep and technical climb or after-work laps on the downhill track, the E-Mythique LT has been tested and developed to deliver.

The VRS version of the E-Mythique is built around a 170mm SR Suntour Durolux36 fork and RockShox Deluxe Select R rear shock with 160mm of travel. The drivetrain is a mixed SRAM NX/SX Eagle 12-speed setup and braking is handled by the TRP Slate EVO 4-piston hydraulic disk brakes. Rounding out the build are tubeless WTB rims and a Nukeproof Neutron cockpit.

The new Bafang M510 motor system

To build an eMTB that performs exceptionally well, we partnered with a new drive unit manufacturer for Vitus, choosing Bafang and their M510 drive unit.

With a maximum torque of 95Nm and competitive system weight, the M510 is the perfect drive unit to power the E-Mythique LT. We developed a close partnership with Bafang and tuned the system to perform exactly to our needs, effectively cherry-picking the best features and incorporating them into our drive unit.

The M510 system is powered by an integrated 630Wh battery and a display with five custom power modes — Eco, Eco-plus, Trail, Boost, and Race — giving the rider maximum options for adjusting range and on-trail performance.

Combining this drive unit with our experience in suspension and geometry design, we have created an eMTB to be proud of. It's made to be ridden everywhere; from steep, rough trails to big days with big climbs .

The E-Mythique LT is designed to get the most out of eMTB’ing, whatever you might want that to be.

The E-Mythique LT VRS component details

SR Suntour Durolux36 & Deluxe Select R suspension

Smooth Bafang M510 motor produces 250W max power and 95Nm torque

Long range 630Wh internal battery

Wide range SRAM NX/SX Eagle 1x12 speed drivetrain

Powerful TRP Slate EVO 4 piston hydraulic disc brakes

Tubeless ready WTB rims with grippy Vee Tyres
